Fig. 4. Overview of the completeness evolution in multi-tool agents. The framework characterizes functional completeness as a continual process with three sequential yet interrelated stages: capability boundary perception, which identifies missing tools, ambiguous intents, and parameter anomalies through clarification and safe termination; autonomous tool expansion, which compensates for capability gaps via tool creation, tool synthesis, API integration, and composite skill construction; and open environment adaptation, which consolidates successful tools and interaction traces into reusable experience memory to support dynamic updating and long-term evolution in changing environments.
